data.name: Little Crimson Heroes
data.detailed_description:
Little Crimson Heroes is a cute 3D tower defense strategy game.

The iron boots of the White Moon Federation have crossed the Hundred Flowers Field. Biochemical monsters, flesh machines, and mutated war vehicles are closing in on the Red Star Republic step by step. The homeland is in danger, and the flames of war have already been lit. Facing a powerful invader, the Red Star Republic has no path of retreat. It can only build a line of defense with steel, protect its land with courage, and stop the enemy’s advance with the bodies of its young fighters.

Here, every hill may become a battlefield, and every road may erupt into combat. Players will command the young fighters of the Red Star Republic, deploying defensive towers, soldiers, and tactical units according to the map terrain and enemy types, building a red defense line that cannot be easily broken.

This is not just a simple tower defense battle. It is a strategic test of defense, sacrifice, coordination, and counterattack.

Hold the position. Give up not a single inch.

Enemies will launch attacks from different routes. Plains, mountains, roads, and narrow passes will all affect the course of battle.

On flat ground, machine-gun positions can provide continuous firepower and suppress waves of incoming enemies. In mountainous terrain, cannons can bombard distant targets and destroy heavy enemy units. Against the White Moon Federation’s mutated war vehicles, landmines are the most reliable countermeasure. When enemies attempt to break through the route, broadsword squads and assault troops can step forward to block their advance.

There is no perfect defense line. Only by reading the battlefield clearly and deploying units wisely can you defend every inch of the Red Star Republic’s land.

Different tower types counter different enemies.

The White Moon Federation is most skilled in biotechnology and biochemical weapons. Its army is not made up of ordinary soldiers alone, but also flesh-built machines, grotesquely modified weapons, and massive, terrifying biological war vehicles.

To face these enemies, players must choose the right tower types for the right countermeasures.

Machine guns are suited for suppressing large numbers of enemies. Cannons are suited for attacking heavy targets. Landmines are ideal for ambushing war vehicles. Soldier units can block enemy routes at critical positions. Each unit has its own mission, and only proper use can create a true battlefield advantage.

Combine towers to create tactical effects.

The defense line of the Red Star Republic is not made up of isolated positions.

Different tower types can work together to create special effects. The cooperation between machine guns, cannons, landmines, and soldier units can change the rhythm of firepower, control the battlefield, and shift the tide of war.

You can try different defensive combinations and create your own tactical style. Will you use heavy firepower to suppress the enemy head-on, or use landmines and soldiers to delay them before concentrating cannon fire to wipe them out? The answer belongs to the battlefield—and to you.

Enter the battle yourself and strike with precision.

At critical moments, players can personally take control of each tower for precise attacks.

When enemy war vehicles break through the front line, when biochemical monsters approach the position, and when the final defense line is about to be torn apart, you are not just a commander watching from afar. You can take direct control of cannons, machine guns, or soldier units, aim at the enemy’s weak points, and deliver the decisive blow that changes the battle.

Every young fighter can be controlled individually. Every position may become the key to turning the tide.

A red battlefield in a cute 3D style.

The game uses a cute 3D visual style to portray a war-themed world, giving the heavy battlefield a more vivid and unique visual identity.

The steel defenses of the Red Star Republic, the flesh machines of the White Moon Federation, and the smoke of war rising over the Hundred Flowers Field together create a world that is cute, passionate, and filled with strange fantasy elements.

This is a battle of young fighters against a massive invasion machine.
This is a battle to defend the homeland with wisdom and courage.

Endless Mode: the defense line never goes out.

In addition to regular levels, the game also offers an Endless Mode.

Enemies will come wave after wave, and their attacks will become increasingly fierce. You must continuously strengthen your defenses, adjust your combinations, personally control key units, and hold out for as long as possible.

As long as the position still stands, the battle is not over.
As long as the young fighters remain, the red defense line will never fall.

data.short_description: Little Crimson Heroes is a cute 3D tower defense game. Command young fighters of the Red Star Republic, build defenses, deploy machine guns, cannons, mines, and troops, then take direct control to stop the White Moon Federation’s invasion. Hold the line!
